description: This file contains unit tests for the NationalityDao class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin, covering CRUD operations and validation methods related to nationalities.

classes.name: NationalityDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the NationalityDao data access object, verifying operations such as add, edit, retrieve, delete, and validation of nationality entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of NationalityDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testAddNationality
methods.description: Tests the ability to add a new nationality and verify its persistence.

methods.name: testEditNationality
methods.description: Tests editing an existing nationality record.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a list of nationalities based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a nationality by its unique ID.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a nationality record based on its name, including case-insensitivity and trimming.

methods.name: testDeleteNationalities
methods.description: Verifies deletion of multiple nationality records.

methods.name: testIsExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks whether the DAO correctly detects existing nationality names.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Verifies behavior when attempting to delete non-existing nationality records.
